records.name: Saint Anne's National Shrine, Kattimahana
records.summary_en: Kattimahana is a distinct Catholic St Anne pilgrimage shrine in Dummalasuriya, not Talawila. Sri Lanka's official Gazette of 16 August 2024 explicitly calls it the 'Kurunegala (North-Western) Catholic Diocese's 129th Annual Feast of Kattimahana St. Anna National Shrine', with festival on 24–25 August 2024. A parliamentary 2018 Department of Christian Religious Affairs report also lists Kattimahana under Kurunegala and distinguishes Talawila under Chilaw. This materially resolves the prior jurisdiction ambiguity in favour of Kurunegala for these official records, notwithstanding a conflicting secondary GCatholic listing. The original ecclesiastical national-shrine decree is not in hand.
records.summary_fr: Kattimahana est un sanctuaire catholique de sainte Anne à Dummalasuriya, distinct de Talawila. La Gazette officielle du Sri Lanka du 16 août 2024 le désigne expressément comme sanctuaire national relevant du diocèse catholique de Kurunegala et annonce la fête des 24 et 25 août 2024. Un rapport parlementaire de 2018 classe aussi Kattimahana sous Kurunegala, mais Talawila sous Chilaw. Ces pièces officielles éclaircissent la contradiction de juridiction, malgré un annuaire secondaire divergent. Le décret ecclésiastique original érigeant le sanctuaire national reste introuvable.

evidence.support: Official 2024 pilgrimage notice explicitly naming Kurunegala Catholic Diocese and national shrine

evidence.issuer: Sri Lankan Parliament / Department of Christian Religious Affairs

records.name: Claimed Our Lady of Fatima Shrine, Dili
records.summary_en: The candidate title 'Shrine of Our Lady of Fatima, Dili' is not established by a current diocesan shrine decree. The Sanctuary of Fatima's worldwide catalogue separately lists a church under ambiguous 'Suai-Dili', a Fatima grotto at Balide mission, and a pilgrim-statue grotto in Manatuto, whose devotional history traces a Fatima niche to 1936. These are distinct locations; the catalogue's diocesan label Dili is not proof that the Suai church is physically in Dili. No Dili shrine, opening schedule or coordinates are certified.
records.summary_fr: Le titre « Sanctuaire Notre-Dame de Fátima, Díli » n'est pas étayé par un décret diocésain actuel. Le répertoire mondial du sanctuaire de Fátima distingue une église indiquée « Suai-Dili », une grotte mariale de la mission de Balide et une grotte de la Vierge pèlerine à Manatuto, où la dévotion est attestée dès les années 1930. Ce sont des lieux différents ; la mention du diocèse de Díli ne situe pas l'église de Suai dans la ville de Díli. Aucun sanctuaire autonome, horaire ni point cartographique n'est certifié.

records.name: Rabban Hormizd Monastery, Alqosh
records.summary_en: The Chaldean Patriarchate's Jubilee 2025 pastoral letter identifies Rabban Hormizd as a pilgrimage heritage site. Mesopotamia Heritage's detailed site documentation establishes that the historic mountain monastery is physically separate from the Monastery of Our Lady of the Seeds, completed on the plain in 1858 under Patriarch Joseph VI Audo. The old complex contains the founder's burial tradition and monastic/patriarchal tombs, but individual relic authenticity and contemporary access have not been certified. The documentation's historical site coordinates were not imported into the canonical map.
records.summary_fr: La lettre pastorale du patriarcat chaldéen pour le Jubilé 2025 mentionne Rabban Hormizd parmi les lieux de pèlerinage patrimonial. L'inventaire de Mesopotamia Heritage distingue formellement le monastère ancien accroché à la montagne de Notre-Dame-des-Moissons, achevé dans la plaine en 1858 sous le patriarche Joseph VI Audo. Le site ancien conserve la tradition du tombeau du fondateur et des sépultures monastiques et patriarcales ; l'authenticité de chaque relique et l'accès actuel ne sont pas certifiés. Aucune coordonnée n'a été ajoutée à la carte canonique.

records.name: Mirinae Catholic Shrine, Anseong
records.summary_en: The Diocese of Suwon's own shrine page verifies Mirinae as the burial place of Saint Andrew Kim Tae-gon and describes several separate chapels, tombs, public Masses and 09:00–17:00 shrine access. Diocesan news dated 26 October 2022 reports authentication certificates for relics identified as Saint Andrew Kim's vertebra and Saint Perpetua's remains, and the planned transfer of his jawbone to the memorial church. The precise identity of which Saint Perpetua is represented was explicitly unresolved in diocesan reporting. The shrine's diocesan webpage gives street number 416 while the Korean bishops' directory gives 420; both are preserved pending entrance-level reconciliation.
records.summary_fr: La présentation officielle du diocèse de Suwon confirme que Mirinae conserve la tombe de saint André Kim Tae-gon, plusieurs églises et sépultures, des messes publiques et un accès indiqué de 9 h à 17 h. Des nouvelles diocésaines du 26 octobre 2022 relatent des certificats d'authenticité pour une vertèbre attribuée à saint André Kim et des restes attribués à sainte Perpétue, ainsi que le transfert prévu de la mâchoire du martyr. L'identité précise de la sainte Perpétue concernée demeure incertaine. Le diocèse indique le numéro 416, l'annuaire épiscopal le 420 : les deux adresses sont conservées en attente de vérification de l'entrée.

records.name: Our Lady Mother of Divine Providence National Shrine, Cupey
records.summary_en: The Cupey Alto national shrine project is distinct from the historic Marian image in San Juan Cathedral. A first-hand visitor description reports accessible outdoor Stations of the Cross and park grounds, while a public 6 October 2026 repost of the San Juan Archdiocese's liturgical announcements advertises a Rosary gathering and Mass at the Cupey sanctuary on 10 October 2026. This materially strengthens evidence of use of the grounds, but the primary archdiocesan announcement and completed status of the proposed main sanctuary building were not independently obtained. Do not equate functioning outdoor grounds with a finished basilica.

records.name: Claimed Our Lady of Lourdes Shrine, Tianjin

The independently listed Tianjin Wanghailou church is dedicated to Our Lady of Victory, not Lourdes; a known Lourdes church at Tangmuqiao belongs to Shanghai, not Tianjin. records.name: Tắc Sậy Pilgrimage Centre — Blessed Francis Xavier Trương Bửu Diệp
records.summary_en: The Dicastery for the Causes of Saints records Blessed Francis Xavier Trương Bửu Diệp's beatification on 2 July 2026 in Cà Mau and explicitly gives his liturgical memorial as 12 March. Vatican News independently confirms that the ceremony took place at Tắc Sậy pilgrimage centre and that his burial is associated with the shrine. The memorial date is not the beatification anniversary and must not be represented as a universal 1962-calendar feast. The present tomb/relic custody and chapel geometry remain held.

Vatican News confirme la cérémonie au centre de pèlerinage de Tắc Sậy et l'association du tombeau au sanctuaire. Le 12 mars ne doit être confondu ni avec l'anniversaire de la béatification ni avec une fête universelle du calendrier de 1962. La localisation actuelle du tombeau et l'inventaire des reliques restent à contrôler.

records.name: Church of the Nativity of the Blessed Virgin Mary, Hougang
records.summary_en: The unmatched R70 candidate is already the canonical Hougang Catholic church. Singapore's National Heritage Board documents the historic building, two side chapels, five priestly tombs in the nave and the Marian statue gifted by Sultan Ibrahim of Johor. A Singapore Catholic parish's February 2026 bulletin independently lists a March 2026 penitential service at this church, supporting active liturgical use. These tombs must not be labelled relics of canonized saints. Preserve the existing Place ID.
